summary.name: OpenRocket
summary.one_liner: OpenRocket is a free model rocket simulator for designing and simulating rockets before building and flying them.
use_cases: Designing a model rocket before building it
Choosing a suitable motor for a rocket design
Checking rocket stability via center of pressure and gravity
Planning multi-stage or dual deployment flights
Exporting rocket design drawings to PDF for building
summary.what_it_does: OpenRocket lets users design model rockets and simulate their flight using six-degrees-of-freedom simulation with over 50 variables. Performance values such as center of pressure, center of gravity, maximum altitude, max velocity and stability update in real time in design mode. Users can choose from a catalog of components and materials or create their own, and can search a ThrustCurve motor database to find suitable motors. The page also mentions a rocket optimizer that adjusts parameters toward a goal, support for staging, event triggers and cluster layouts, and PDF export of design drawings.
notable: Six-degrees-of-freedom flight simulation with over 50 variables
Real-time updates of stability and performance while designing
Open source, with contribution and GitHub issue tracking
caveats: Supported operating systems are not named on the page
